46:t_004:14.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Both the $$マクロス・クォーター$$ and the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ have taken considerable damage. If we keep taking attacks like this, heading for the Central Continent is out of the question.」

46:t_004:15.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All units, launch. If the ceasefire is not accepted, we will return fire in self-defense.」

46:t_005:1.en:
$$海賊$$
「Let's shoot them all down and take them to $$ラケージ$$ as a souvenir!」

46:t_005:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「This is Colonel $$ジェフリー・ワイルダー$$, captain of the $$マクロス・クォーター$$.」

46:t_005:3.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We harbor no hostility. Cease your attack at once and agree to a meeting with us.」

46:t_006:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「Those guys think they can fight us with that kind of equipment...!」

46:t_006:1.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「They don't seem to get the difference in strength, do they?」

46:t_006:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「Then let's show them that difference.」

46:t_006:3.en:
$n
「That's probably the quickest way to avoid a needless fight, too.」

46:t_006:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「However, it is true that it's an effective move.」

46:t_006:6.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「What are your orders, Captain?」

46:t_006:7.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It can't be helped. I authorize attacking in self-defense.」

46:t_007:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n... Will you be all right by yourself?」

46:t_007:1.en:
$n
「Major $$オズマ$$ has given me permission to act on my own.」

46:t_007:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Are you bothered by what that man $$サルディアス$$ said?」

46:t_007:3.en:
$n
「...It's as if I obtained the $$ジェニオン$$'s $$スフィア$$ in exchange for $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s life.」

46:t_007:4.en:
$n
「That's why I... want to learn to master the $$スフィア$$, to repay him if nothing else.」

46:t_007:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「So you deliberately fight at a disadvantage to train yourself.」

46:t_007:6.en:
$n
「I'm sorry... I've ended up troubling Miss $$スズネ$$ too.」

46:t_007:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You want to get stronger... The way you fight hasn't changed, $n.」

46:t_007:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「This is just this once. From now on, talk it over with me properly, your partner. And...」

46:t_007:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Make sure you protect me, okay?」

46:t_008:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n... Will you be all right by yourself?」

46:t_008:1.en:
$n
「Major $$オズマ$$ has given me permission to act on my own.」

46:t_008:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「But what on earth is it for?」

46:t_008:3.en:
$n
「...It's as if I obtained the $$ジェニオン$$'s $$スフィア$$ in exchange for $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s life.」

46:t_008:4.en:
$n
「That's why I... want to learn to master the $$スフィア$$, to repay him if nothing else.」

46:t_008:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「So you deliberately fight at a disadvantage to train yourself.」

46:t_008:6.en:
$n
「I'm sorry... I've ended up troubling Miss $$スズネ$$ too.」

46:t_008:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You want to get stronger... The way you fight hasn't changed, $n.」

46:t_008:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「This is just this once. From now on, talk it over with me properly, your partner. And...」

46:t_008:10.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Make sure you protect me, okay?」

46:t_009:0.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Also, targeting the cockpit is forbidden. Causing needless casualties is not a wise course for our future operations.」

46:t_009:2.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Then it's settled, all that's left is to do it! To show them what we've got, we're ending this with a lightning strike!」

46:t_010:0.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Damn, those guys are something! They took care of the pirates in no time!」

46:t_010:1.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Weapons I've never seen before... Those guys might have come from the continent... no, from another planet.」

46:t_010:3.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「This is bad, $$ピニオン$$! Those guys are here too!」

46:t_011:0.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Damn, those guys are something! They won't give the pirates an inch!」

46:t_011:1.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Weapons I've never seen before... Those guys might have come from the continent... no, from another planet.」

46:t_011:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「These guys have the power, but their machines aren't built for combat! If we just push through like this...」

46:t_012:0.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「What the hell is this!?」

46:t_012:1.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「This is bad, $$ピニオン$$! Those guys are here too!」

46:t_013:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Hmph... that $$サルディアス$$. Letting them break through the defense line so easily...」

46:t_013:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「For that matter, why is he the commander of the First Defense Unit while I am put in the position of eating his dust?」

46:t_013:3.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Apparently they were sent to crush us, who came down to Earth.」

46:t_013:4.en:
$$マオ$$
「But compared to the defense force right at the edge of the atmosphere, this one is small...!」

46:t_013:5.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Then first strike wins...! Take them out before they take us out!」

46:t_013:7.en:
$$柿小路$$
「Are we being called fools right from the start...!?」

46:t_013:8.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What the heck! After the smooth-talking old guy, now it's a stuck-up old guy we've got to fight!」

46:t_013:9.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Heh... Don't think I'm the same as that $$サルディアス$$.」

46:t_013:10.en:
$$ギルター$$
「My name is $$ギルター・ベローネ$$. I came here to finish you off.」

46:t_013:11.en:
$$甲児$$
「Do you think a force that small can stop us!?」

46:t_013:12.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Will you still be able to talk that way once you see this?」

46:t_014:1.en:
$$ルカ$$
「There are people in a place like that...!?」

46:t_014:2.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「You've gotta be kidding me! In the middle of the ocean like this!」

46:t_014:5.en:
$$ギルター$$
「If you move, consider these people's lives gone.」

46:t_014:7.en:
$$ギルター$$
「A legitimate tactic looks like that to you, our enemies, I suppose.」

46:t_014:8.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Now then, if you care about their lives, you'd do well to disarm!」

46:t_014:9.en:
$$アル$$
「Sergeant, the people he is holding hostage have no connection to us at all.」

46:t_014:10.en:
$$宗介$$
「However, involving civilians in combat must be avoided as far as possible.」

46:t_014:11.en:
$$クルツ$$
「$$宗介$$'s right. I'm not gonna sink into being the kind of bastard who settles things with 'it's nothing to do with us' or 'it couldn't be helped'...!」

46:t_014:13.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「What are your orders, Captain?」
